messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — Specter just finished onboarding smoke tests. They saw intermittent 503s from eu-west during burst demo runs (~800 rps). Asking for a temporary regional QPS bump + IP allowlist for the peering provider FastFiber. Also flagging a renewal risk: trial usage lower than expected, want a demo Thursday. Can someone triage and provision? I can share logs.

sam_ops: Ack. Pinging eng-sre. Do we have the exact CIDRs and how long they need the bump?

maria_cs: CIDRs are 198.51.100.0/24 and 2001:db8:abcd::/48. Request is: eu-west -> 1200 qps, ap-south-1 -> 300 qps for 48h (timeboxed). Demo is Thurs 10:00 UTC. Renewal in 21 days — customer is worried about latency/throughput impacting buy-in.

liam_sre: Got it. I'll open a provisional peering + temp rate window. Plan: create ephemeral allowlist, configure TTL for auto-revoke (48h), and route policy to prefer local eu-west capacity. Also recommend pinning to small-quant model during demo to keep token latency low and spinning up a KV-cache warmup job to avoid cold-start spikes.

maria_cs: Specter uses embeddings + chat (search assistant). They want lowest possible latency during live demo, and may ask for a Private eval because they surface PII in some queries. Flagging for AM/sales.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-23_04:12 started by liam_sre; created route eu-west-temp-burst-1739234567

sam_ops: liam — can you apply allowlist + bump now? I'll coordinate timing with the customer's AM and confirm demo readiness.

liam_sre: Applying now. Example internal API call used:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/provision 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"cidrs":["198.51.100.0/24","2001:db8:abcd::/48"],"regions":{"eu-west":1200,"ap-south-1":300},"ttl":172800}'
```

liam_sre: Done. Temporary allowlist created and rate windows applied. Route pinned to small-quant-1 as fallback for the demo. Autorevoke set for 48h (will expire automatically). I also scheduled a KV warmup 30m before the demo.

maria_cs: Amazing — can you DM me the exact revocation time and a short blurb/log export I can share with the customer?

liam_sre: Revocation timestamp (UTC epoch): 1739400967. Provision audit log: /internal/logs/provision/1739234567.txt (internal link). Also note: we added a transient rule to prefer eu-west hosts; if capacity drops we'll fallback to small-quant-1 in region to keep latency bounded.

eden_account: FYI — I flagged a renewal risk in Gainsight: trial engagement is below expected cohort benchmarks. I've added an enablement play: post-demo 1:1 walkthrough, 7-day usage check-in, and a follow-up lab to showcase caching/batching config. We should capture feedback during demo (pain points: latency variance, edge peering).

maria_cs: I'll schedule the enablement session and request feedback form from the customer right after the demo. Thanks team :pray: If the demo goes well we can propose a short Dedicated pilot to lock capacity and mitigate renewal risk.

sam_ops: Noted. I'll keep the on-call loop open during the demo window and will escalate if we see error rates spike beyond threshold.

liam_sre: Adding a quick checklist for the demo: 1) KV-warmup 30m prior, 2) monitor token latency trace on per-route dashboard, 3) throttle fallback metrics, 4) confirm autorevoke at 48h, 5) capture customer feedback link. I'll post a short postmortem after the window.

maria_cs: Perfect — posting invite and prep notes to the customer. Thanks everyone.
